title: Inquisition
summary: Inquisition (May Subd Geog) is a topical heading (replacing AACR1 corporate name headings Inquisition. [place]). It is not subdivided by --History or --History--[...] century, and no period subdivisions are established under it. Additional headings bring out aspects such as defendants and place church history.
validation_rules: Use the topical heading `Inquisition` (May Subd Geog) for works on any aspect of the Inquisition, subdivided geographically as needed, e.g. `Inquisition--Canary Islands`. (H 1676 sec. 1)
The former corporate name form `Inquisition. [place]` (AACR1) is replaced and should not be used. (H 1676 Background)
Do not subdivide `Inquisition` by `--History` or by `--History--[...] century`, and do not establish period subdivisions under it. (H 1676 sec. 2)
Bring out other aspects with additional headings, e.g. a defendant's name or `[place]--Church history` (`Canary Islands--Church history`). (H 1676 sec. 3)

sections.heading: 1. General rule.
sections.text: Assign the heading Inquisition (May Subd Geog) to works o[n any aspect of] the Inquisition.

sections.heading: 2. --History not used.
sections.text: Do not use the subdivision --History or subdivisio[ns of the type] --History--[. . .] century, or establish period subdivisions under this subject.

sections.heading: 3. Assigning a[dditional headings].
sections.text:
Assign additional head[ings if appropriate to bring out] important aspec[ts of the work, such as the name of a defendan]t in a trial, other topical headings, etc. Example:

```
Title: The Inquisition in the Canary Islands.
650 #0 $a Inquisition $z Canary Islands.
651 #0 $a Canary Islands $x Church history.
```
